**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The agreement contains no most-favoured-nation or best-terms mechanic in either direction. Exhibit B (`PRICING`, `REVENUE SHARING FEES`, `PAYMENT TERMS`), § 4 (Fees) and Exhibit D (Sales and Marketing Cooperation) all fix absolute amounts and percentages without any benchmarking to terms given to third parties. Literal and regex sweeps for "most favored/favoured", "no less favorable", "best price/pricing/terms", "preferential", "comparable terms", "other customers/licensees" and "terms and conditions offered to" returned zero hits.

Direction check: Corio (our party) is the licensee paying license, maintenance, MarketSite.net access and revenue-share fees, so any MFN would have burdened us — none exists. This sits at the **preferred** position (no MFN obligation on Customer), so nothing to flag.
